acceptance_criteria.statement: A verdict missing its required fields is refused with verdict_schema_invalid.
An approve verdict carrying a blocking finding is refused with verdict_inconsistent.
A changes_requested verdict with no blocking finding, or one without a failure_scenario, is refused.
needs_owner requires at least one owner decision and is accepted with one.
A verdict whose head differs from the current head is refused with head_moved.
A verdict for another repo or PR is refused with verdict_binding_mismatch.
A verdict whose reviewer family equals the packet author family is refused with review_not_independent.
The approve body's first line is the canonical APPROVE (independent review — identity, model family family) at head line.
The changes_requested first line is canonical and names the first blocking title.
Under auto_reject a changes_requested verdict is posted and reported as posted.
Under auto_reject an approve verdict is queued and the poster is not called.
record_line returns one campaign-record line naming repo#pr, head, verdict, family, attempt and status.

observable_behavior: an inconsistent verdict is refused before rendering
a moved head or a changed repo/PR is refused
auto_reject posts rejections and queues approvals
outcome.summary: Validate a review-verdict/1 against its schema and the packet (repo, PR, head, independence), render the gate-parsed first line, and post under post_mode auto_reject: changes_requested is posted, approve is queued for the owner, needs_owner posts nothing.
